notes.title: Beholder: Conductor Out Now!
notes.content:
The Ministry is pleased to announce Beholder: Conductor is now officially available on Steam! 
You’ve been appointed the senior conductor of the Determination Bringer, the country’s legendary train — where every decision you make on board matters. 

[previewyoutube=hHfZogAzJ7c;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What is Beholder: Conductor? [/b]
It’s a spin-off of the Beholder series — a narrative-driven game where you monitor passengers, enforce the law (or bend it), complete secret missions, and uncover hidden agendas — all while riding a train that everyone’s watching. Spy, search, report... or don’t. Just remember: someone is always watching you too. 

The choices you make throughout the game shape the story — your loyalty, your silence, or your betrayal will all lead to multiple endings. Will you follow orders, or take matters into your own hands? 

Spotted a bug or something that doesn’t look right? Help us maintain order by filling out the bug report [url=https://support.alawar.com/beholder_conductor_en]form[/url]. 

And if your journey leaves an impression, consider sharing your thoughts in a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825530/Beholder_Conductor/]review[/url] — the Ministry listens closely to loyal passengers. 

For the next 10 days, the game will be available at a [b]10% discount[/b]: 

 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825530/Beholder_Conductor 
Your train is ready, comrade. Don’t be late.

notes.title: Karate Survivor is out now!
notes.content:
Are you ready to unleash your inner martial arts master? Karate Survivor is live, ready to throw you into the gritty, fast-paced world of 80s street brawls! 

In this survivor-like roguelite, every corner of the city is your battleground. Fend off relentless thugs using fists, feet, and anything you can get your hands on – from mop handles to plastic flamingos! Your surroundings are part of your arsenal. Push over scaffolding, swing microwave doors, and turn the world into a weapon. 

[previewyoutube=WH_KjiLuvMg;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What awaits you in Karate Survivor: [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Improvised Combat:[/b] Use whatever you can get your hands on to dismantle your enemies. Even a toy hammer can be lethal! 
[*][b] Environmental Warfare: [/b]Manipulate the streets to your advantage. Push objects at enemies, bring down scaffolding, or slam them with a microwave door. 
[*] [b]Dynamic Combos: [/b]Mix and match dozens of attacks into unique six-move combos. Find the most devastating combos to suit your style. 
[*] [b]Progression and Mastery: [/b]Unlock and master techniques that stay with you across runs. Every fight brings you closer to martial arts mastery. 
[*] [b]Fast-paced Runs and Boss Battles: [/b]Face fierce bosses across gritty locations in epic, high-speed showdowns. 
[/list]
Also, we’ll be adding a new challenge mode as a New Game+ with increased difficulty in an upcoming post-release patch for those eager to test their skills. 

Stay tuned and grab Karate Survivor now with a 10% launch discount. Don’t forget to leave a review to support us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027930/Karate_Survivor/

notes.title: Technotopia is Now Available!
notes.content:
[b]Technotopia, a game developed by Yustas and published by Alawar, is now available on Windows and macOS![/b] The city of the future awaits, and it’s your time to take control. 

As the AI Iris, you are tasked with creating the perfect city in a world fractured by social and economic unrest. The metropolis teeters on the edge of chaos, and the balance between competing factions is fragile. Every decision you make will shape the fate of Technotopia – will you build a utopia, or let the city descend into turmoil? 

[previewyoutube=8ZPQsLAHWfg;full][/previewyoutube]

What awaits you in Technotopia: 

[list]
[*] 4 Faction-Driven Questlines: Capitalists, aristocrats, politicians, and common citizens all want control of the city. Navigate their conflicting agendas and choose your allies wisely – each storyline will alter the city’s future. 
[*] 100+ Unique Buildings: Construct skyscrapers, parks, residential zones, and industrial hubs. Every building you place will influence the balance of power, helping or hindering different factions. Strategically combine city blocks to maximize efficiency and unlock special bonuses. 
[*] 50+ Dynamic Events: From everyday mishaps to faction conflicts, every event in Technotopia is shaped by your choices, with consequences that ripple across the city. 
[*] Factions' Influence: Every decision shifts the delicate balance between the city’s ruling groups. Will you appease the elites, or side with the people? 
[*] City News & Criminal Activity: As crime rises, new challenges emerge, forcing you to make tough decisions. Stay informed through real-time news reports that reflect the impact of your actions on the city's order. 
[/list]
Get the game with a [b]10% launch[/b] discount and share your feedback on Technotopia – we’re excited to hear your thoughts! Join our Discord to stay up to date on the latest news. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825110/Technotopia/

notes.title: Do Not Feed the Monkeys 2099 comes to Steam this Fall!
notes.content:
It’s been a long time since your last mission. Things are a little different here in the year 2099. Earth has been left a wasteland and humanity has spread itself across the galaxy, nevertheless, the Primate Observation Club is stronger than ever. 

We are delighted to inform you that the organization has chosen YOU to take part in our most recent observational study. notes.title: Do Not Feed the Monkeys is feeding the monkeys!

Dear Club Members,

We are running a sale on Do Not Feed the Monkeys! [i][b]From 9–19 March you can get the game at a 60% discount.[/b][/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/658850/Do_Not_Feed_the_Monkeys/

Part of the revenue from the sale will go to the Rainfer primate rescue center. The organization helps primates in captivity, providing them with medical aid and creating the right conditions for their rehabilitation and socialization.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007907/ba738d70bee648e9cfe433d048d9da30f3038ebd.png[/img]
[i]Photo: Rainfer[/i]

There are some people who think a chimpanzee makes for a good pet. By the time they realize that the animal isn't suited to captivity, it's too late. Chimpanzees are frequently forced to perform unnatural tricks in circuses for audiences' amusement. Many primates are kept in zoos with unimaginable conditions, unable to get the care and companionship they need. Rainfer helps these animals to recover from their traumas and return to their natural habitats.

The Center is currently home to chimpanzees, gibbons, orangutans and capuchin monkeys. 

[url=http://rainfer.com/our-mission/]Find out more about the Center's work.[/url]

notes.title: Return of The Obra Dinn, Paratopic and Hypnospace Outlaw headline IGF s 2019 finalists
notes.content:
The finalists for the 2019 Independent Games Festival award ceremony on March 20th have been announced, and they remind me just how joyful a challenge it is to keep up with indie development. Every category is packed with exciting, creative endeavours both complete or still in development – a reminder that 2018 was a great year for games, and 2019 stands to be even better. Now I’ve just got to keep track of all of them.

Among the headliners for the Seumas McNally Grand Prize are RPS favourites like low-fi groundhog day adventure Minit, the excellent maritime mystery Return Of The Obra Dinn (which Andreas Inderwildi picked apart earlier today) and the bizarre Hypnospace Outlaw, a deep dive into a fictional 90s internet dream-world. Also in the running is virtual voyeur sim Do Not Feed The Monkeys, and the upcoming physics-driven platform roguelike Noita. Every category is full of exciting games, though – check out the full list on the IGF page here, or below.

notes.title: Wildlife monkeys awarded in Hamburg!
notes.content:
It’s been a month since we set [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/658850/Do_Not_Feed_the_Monkeys/]our monkeys[/url] free, and we want to [b]thank you all[/b] for such a warm welcome.

Thousands of players around the world have played with our monkeys and their everyday life (some of them even dared to feed them, can you imagine?). Plus, the game has been featured in [b]lots of media[/b] with [url=https://www.devuego.es/bd/criticas/do-not-feed-the-monkeys]great reviews[/url]; dozens and dozens of [b]gameplay videos[/b] are on-line on YouTube and Twitch; [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/658850/Do_Not_Feed_the_Monkeys/#app_reviews_hash]almost 900 reviews[/url] have been submitted to Steam so far, [b]91% of them being positive.[/b]

It all means most players are [b]loving[/b] [i]Do Not Feed the Monkeys[/i]… and we can’t be happier about it.

On behalf of the [url=http://www.fictiorama.com/en/]Fictiorama[/url], [url=https://blg-publishing.com/]Badland[/url] and [url=https://company.alawar.com/en/]Alawar Premium[/url] teams… [b]thanks SO MUCH![/b]

To top it all off, a few weeks ago we showcased [i]Do Not Feed the Monkey[/i]s at [url=https://playfestival.de/en/]PLAY18[/url], a festival that takes place every year in Hamburg (Germany). We had a wonderful time at the event, firstly because of the [b]love[/b] the festival’s staff shows for games, developers and visitors. Every game in the exhibition featured a customized booth… and, to be honest, we never saw a setup for [i]Do Not Feed the Monkeys[/i] as cool as the one they made for the game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30007907/5ff31f6b46f1ac1704f6f332436e90284b829315.jpg[/img]

The game was a finalist in the [url=https://play18.playfestival.de/en/category/nominees/]Most Creative Game[/url] category, along with the fun [url=https://www.alistairaitcheson.com/games/thebookritual.html]The Book Ritual[/url] by Alistair Aitcheson (that features a real, working paper shredder!), and the beautifully touching [url=http://www.mychildlebensborn.com/]My Child Lebensborn[/url] by Teknopilot & Sarepta Studio.

After a really fun ceremony hosted by Alistair Aitcheson himself, that included some crazy Sonic competitions… it happened that the jury decided to award [b]Do Not Feed the Monkeys[/b] the [b]Most Creative Game[/b] prize!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30007907/d15edab7c62e71c7597a7baa2e69a8ba77c3dea4.jpg[/img]

The Most Innovative Newcomer as well as the Audience prizes were awarded to [url=https://www.facebook.com/SymbioTheGame]Symbio[/url], a cooperative platformer that makes players hold hands to overcome obstacles.

Besides, we had the chance to play games as cool as [i]Riot, Baba is You, It’s Paper Guy!, Segelbootepusten, Not Tonight, Fuir la Guerre, GetBadNews, Oddly Assorted, Vandals[/i] and so many more. Some of them have not been released yet, so it was great to have the chance to give them a try!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30007907/bbdf6df0b97b160bc10a2801ccc89d32a1b20eef.jpg[/img]

Thanks a lot to the staff, jury, developers and visitors that participated in PLAY18. We had an awesome time!

And, well, if you love video games… [b]do not miss PLAY19 next year![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30007907/6e694c70a932d177523c1fa101931af3901dcdf4.jpg[/img]

Fictiorama’s darkly comical voyeurism simulator Do Not Feed The Monkeys implores you to merely observe and not interact, but you probably won’t be able to resist pushing a few buttons here and there. Released yesterday and the latest in the growing genre of Orwellian panopticon simulators, Do Not Feed The Monkeys has you juggling your own character’s needs while meddling in the affairs of others through hacked cameras. notes.title: Do Not Feed The Monkeys (but definitely spy on em)
notes.content: Do Not Feed The Monkeys [official site] is the newly announced digital voyeurism project from Fictiorama Studios. You might remember them from point-n-clicker Dead Synchronicity: Tomorrow Comes Today, but this is more in the vein of exploring surveillance culture rather than the aftermath of an apocalypse. My main observation from the trailer is that as a UK citizen I cannot hear In The Hall Of The Mountain King without assuming we’re off to Alton Towers. (more…)
